body: 1 The amount of earners' levy payable for the 2025/26 tax year is, for all earners, except those described in paragraphs (b) and (c), $1.45 per $100 of earnings. 2 The amount of earners' levy payable for the 2026/27 tax year is, for all earners, except those described in paragraphs (b) and (c), $1.52 per $100 of earnings. 3 The amount of earners' levy payable for the 2027/28 tax year, and any later tax year, is, for all earners, except those described in paragraphs (b) and (c), $1.59 per $100 of earnings. 4 Subclauses (1) to (3) are subject to regulation 5.

1 The maximum amount of earnings, for the purposes of calculating the earners' levy for the 2025/26 tax year on which an earner must pay an earners' levy, is $152,790. 2 The maximum amount of earnings, for the purposes of calculating the earners' levy for the 2026/27 tax year on which an earner must pay an earners' levy, is $156,641. 3 The maximum amount of earnings, for the purposes of calculating the earners' levy for the 2027/28 tax year, and for any later tax year, on which an earner must pay an earners' levy, is $160,244.

1 Subclause (2) applies to a self-employed person who, in the 2025/26 tax year, worked for an average of more than 30 hours per week, whether or not as an employee, and earned less than $49,365. 2 The person must pay the earners' levy calculated using the following formula: 1.45 x [($49,365 - a) / 100], where a is the amount of the person's earnings as an employee in the 2025/26 tax year. 3 Subclause (4) applies to a self-employed person who, in the 2026/27 tax year, worked for an average of more than 30 hours per week, whether or not as an employee, and earned less than $50,501. 4 The person must pay the earners' levy calculated using the following formula: 1.52 x [($50,501 - a) / 100], where a is the amount of the person's earnings as an employee in the 2026/27 tax year. 5 Subclause (6) applies to a self-employed person who, in the 2027/28 tax year, or any later tax year, worked for an average of more than 30 hours per week, whether or not as an employee, and earned less than $51,632. 6 The person must pay the earners' levy calculated using the following formula: 1.59 x [($51,632 - a) / 100], where a is the amount of the person's earnings as an employee in the tax year.

1 Subclause (2) applies to a self-employed person who, in relation to the 2025/26 tax year, enters into an agreement with the Corporation under section 209 of the Act to purchase weekly compensation. 2 The person must pay the earners' levy calculated using the following formula: 1.45 x [(1.25 x a) / 100], where a is the agreed level of weekly compensation purchased by the self-employed person under section 209 of the Act adjusted to an annual figure. 3 Subclause (4) applies to a self-employed person who, in relation to the 2026/27 tax year, enters into an agreement with the Corporation under section 209 of the Act to purchase weekly compensation. 4 The person must pay the earners' levy calculated using the following formula: 1.52 x [(1.25 x a) / 100], where a is the agreed level of weekly compensation purchased by the self-employed person under section 209 of the Act adjusted to an annual figure. 5 Subclause (6) applies to a self-employed person who, in relation to the 2027/28 tax year, or any later tax year, enters into an agreement with the Corporation under section 209 of the Act to purchase weekly compensation. 6 The person must pay the earners' levy calculated using the following formula: 1.59 x [(1.25 x a) / 100], where a is the agreed level of weekly compensation purchased by the self-employed person under section 209 of the Act adjusted to an annual figure.
The amounts of earners' levies in these regulations are exclusive of any goods and services tax payable on the levy.

1 This regulation applies in respect of any invoice that is issued to a self-employed person for the purposes of the Act and includes the earners' levy. 2 The relevant exempt amount for the purposes of section 244 of the Act is $40.
